text:
sec-bot: ALERT: Rapid session revoke burst for user j.martin@acme-corp.com — 12 revokes in 2m. Geo hops: EU -> US -> EU within 5m. Risk: possible cookie-rotation via proxy chain. Suspected MFA prompt fatigue attempts. Investigate.

 dmitri: on it. which logs do we have? any associated failed logins or push rejects?

 kate: saw same in auth-proxy. IPs are rotating: 185.62.34.12, 45.77.90.3, 193.8.12.4 — ASN looks like cloud-hosting providers. no obvious user agent change.

 kate: quick splunk query I ran:
 ```
 index=auth_logs user="j.martin@acme-corp.com" earliest=-10m | stats count by src_ip,geo,ua
 ```

 ben: containment plan: 1) block those IPs at WAF, 2) revoke active sessions for affected users (targeted), 3) temporarily increase push backoff to reduce MFA fatigue risk.

 riley: agree on targeted session revoke. do NOT rotate customer KMS keys — only rotate service tokens if we see API key misuse.

 dmitri: I'll run mass session revoke for the 8 affected accounts and add a temporary rate-limit rule for /sso/auth endpoints. executing now.

 oncall: taking this incident. coordinating with support to message affected customers and to log CS tickets.

 support-bot: Draft sent to #support-ops for review: "We detected unusual sign-in activity on your account. We've revoked active sessions and asked you to re-authenticate. If you see unexpected prompts, contact support." :information_source:

 alice: post-incident asks: add an alert for 'session_revoke_rate > 5 per user per 5m', add RBAC check for service accounts issuing session tokens, and instrument auth proxy for 'x-forwarded-for' chain anomalies.

 ben: also add a runbook step to check for 'MFA push flood' signals (excessive push sends without accept) and a throttle at the push gateway.

 dmitri: noted. actions assigned: sec/alerts (create alert), eng-auth (review cookie/session lifetime and SameSite), infra (blocklist and WAF tuning), support (customer comms). I'll create the ticket and tag owners. :white_check_mark:

 riley: will follow up on KMS integration logs — confirm no unexpected decrypts. posting KMS access query in the ticket.

 sec-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1798. Keep thread for updates.
